Bearer.description: An API key, an access token from a configured authorization server, or a client assertion. Credentials do not cross surfaces: one provisioned for the administrative endpoint authenticates nothing on the client endpoint, and the reverse.

info.description: Every operation MailFathom serves over HTTP, across both of its API surfaces. The administrative surface is what the mfctl command reaches; the client surface is what the MailFathom client reaches. Each answers on a listener of its own under credentials of its own, and a deployment serves only the surfaces its operator enabled — so an operation described here answers only where the surface it belongs to is published.
info.title: MailFathom HTTP API
